==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number", "story name" and "formatted name" with the appropriate information.<br />
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>Valkyrie|''ISSUE NUMBER''|''STORY NAME''|''FORMATTED NAME'' (optional)}}

==Examples==
*{{Valkyrie|19|Operation Phoenix}}
*{{Valkyrie|issue1=19|issue2=20|story=Flight of the Jedi}}
